skill.name: email-creative-builder
skill.description: Use when drafting one email creative for a campaign, newsletter, or cold-outbound message. It creates subject variants, preheader copy, body copy, one primary CTA, a plain-text alternate, and claim flags. It does not score deliverability, run SEND audits, design sequences, or build A/B test plans.
skill.summary: Builds message-matched email creative with subject variants, CTA copy, plain-text alternate, and claim checks.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

content.value_statement: Teams need email copy that keeps subject lines, body claims, and landing pages aligned. This skill turns campaign inputs into ready-to-review creative with claim flags, one CTA, and a plain-text version.
actual_capabilities: Drafts 3 to 5 subject-line variants with a matched preheader.
Writes structured email body copy for promo, cold-outbound, and newsletter modes.
Creates one primary CTA that points to the stated destination.
Adds a plain-text alternate for accessibility and deliverability hygiene.
Flags claims that need source evidence or approved ledger wording.
Produces handoff notes for testing or quality audit workflows.
limitations: It does not score deliverability, spam risk, or SEND quality metrics.
It needs a destination URL or page copy to verify message match.
It cannot validate claims unless approved evidence or ledger entries are provided.
It does not send emails or operate ESP accounts directly.

use_cases.title: Launch a Promotional Email
use_cases.description: Create offer-led subject lines, body copy, CTA text, and a plain-text alternate for a campaign.

use_cases.title: Draft Cold Outreach
use_cases.description: Write a concise B2B email that uses one verified personalization signal and a low-pressure ask.

use_cases.title: Prepare Newsletter Creative
use_cases.description: Build a value-led newsletter section with clear sponsor disclosure and one primary reader action.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Promo Email
prompt_templates.prompt: Write an email for this offer: [offer]. Use promo mode. Destination page: [URL]. Include 5 subject lines, one preheader, body copy, one CTA, and a plain-text alternate.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Cold-Outbound Email
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a cold-outbound email to [persona] about [offer]. Personalize only with this verified signal: [signal]. Use this destination or reply goal: [URL or goal].

prompt_templates.title: Iterate Existing Email Copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this email while keeping the same offer and CTA: [paste copy]. Destination page: [URL]. Preserve any proven claims and flag unsupported claims.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Audit-Ready Creative Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced handoff to testing or QA
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an audit-ready email creative for [offer], [persona], and [URL]. Include subject variants with labels, message-match notes, claim-source flags, one CTA, plain text, and handoff notes for testing.

output_examples.input: A marketer asks for a promo email for a limited-time product discount and provides the landing page.
output: Five labeled subject-line options, each tied to one angle.
A matched preheader, short body copy, one CTA, and a plain-text alternate.
Notes showing which claims match the landing page and which need evidence.

output_examples.input: A sales team needs a cold email using one verified buying signal for a target account.
output: A concise email with one genuine personalization line.
A low-pressure reply CTA instead of a hard sell.
A warning if a proof point or customer claim lacks a source.

output_examples.input: A newsletter operator needs sponsor copy that stays separate from editorial content.
output: A value-led newsletter section with a clearly labeled sponsorship block.
One primary reader action and a plain-text version.
Message-match notes for the sponsor offer and destination page.

best_practices: Provide the offer, audience, destination URL, brand voice, and any approved claim wording.
Use one primary CTA so the email has one clear job.
Send the finished creative to testing or quality audit before launch.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent discounts, statistics, guarantees, or testimonials.
Do not use it as a substitute for deliverability scoring or legal review.
Do not mix promo, cold-outbound, and newsletter goals in one email.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates subject-line variants, preheader text, body copy, one CTA, a plain-text alternate, and handoff notes.

faq.question: Does it send emails?
faq.answer: No. It only drafts and prepares creative for review, testing, or ESP setup.

faq.question: Can it write cold outbound emails?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports cold-outbound mode when you provide a persona, offer, and verified personalization signal.

faq.question: Does it check whether claims are true?
faq.answer: It flags unsupported claims and uses approved wording when provided. It does not independently prove claims.

faq.question: How does it use the destination URL?
faq.answer: It uses the page as the message-match anchor for subject promises, body claims, and CTA wording.

faq.question: When should I use another skill?
faq.answer: Use a quality auditor for SEND scoring, a subject lab for pre-scoring, or an experiment designer for A/B plans.
